description: Nawab of Awadh in his fifties, full rounded face, thick black beard, ornate jewelled turban with aigrette, richly embroidered gold brocade angarkha and pearl necklaces, serene melancholic expression, mid-19th-century Lucknow court dress

regal woman in her thirties, dignified oval face, dark hair beneath a fine embroidered dupatta and jewelled tiara, richly worked silk peshwaz, gold and emerald ornaments, resolute commanding expression, mid-19th-century Awadhi queenly attire

young prince in his late teens, clean smooth face, small moustache, jewelled turban with plume, brocade sherwani with sash of office, youthful earnest expression, mid-19th-century Lucknow princely dress

stern cleric-commander in his sixties, weathered face, long grey beard, green turban of a sufi maulvi, plain dark robe over chain mail glimpsed at the collar, fierce zealous gaze, 1857 rebel-leader appearance

elderly Rajput taluqdar warlord in his sixties, lined proud face, thick greying moustache and beard, saffron turban, quilted campaign coat with talwar hilt visible, unyielding defiant expression, 1857 Awadh commander

aged zamindar general near eighty, thin dignified face, long white flowing beard and moustache, white turban, simple white campaign robes with a sword belt, calm indomitable expression, 1857 Jagdishpur commander

elderly Muslim reformer in his seventies, spectacled scholarly face, short white beard, tall karakul cap, dark buttoned achkan over waistcoat, thoughtful modernist expression, late-19th-century Aligarh dress

middle-aged man mid-forties, handsome clean-shaven face, white Gandhi cap, white achkan with a rosebud at the lapel, composed confident expression, 1930s Indian nationalist dress
scholar-socialist in his late forties, thin intellectual face, round spectacles, short moustache, white cap and khadi kurta, earnest contemplative expression, 1930s Congress Socialist appearance

young revolutionary in his mid-twenties, lean determined face, prominent upturned handlebar moustache, hair swept back, plain dhoti-kurta or simple shirt, intense defiant expression, 1920s-30s Indian revolutionary

aristocrat-revolutionary in his fifties, broad face, greying moustache, simple turban or bare head, plain traveller's coat, idealistic far-sighted expression, early-20th-century exile-provisional leader
Awadh courtier-commander in his forties, sharp featured face, dark moustache, jewelled turban, brocade angarkha with sash, shrewd resolute expression, mid-19th-century Lucknow court-rebel dress
